g.text: Reverse-engineering the IOI circuit in GPT-2-small: 26 heads across 7 classes, in 3 stages.
The IOI task + circuit at a glance
Task: 'When John and Mary went to the shops, John gave the bag to _' → answer: Mary.
The circuit: 7 classes of heads working in 3 stages.
Metric: logit difference at END position
positive = model picks Mary (correct) | negative = model picks John (wrong)
clean model: ~+3.6 on baseline; corrupted (swap names): ~-3.6
Logit attribution: which components write toward Mary vs John?
Correlational method: score each residual-stream contribution against the logit_diff direction.
Decompose final residual stream at END position
Project each component onto the logit_diff direction:
Since softmax normalization is the same,
Activation patching: swap in clean acts, measure recovery
Run corrupted prompt, PATCH in one activation from clean run, measure how much logit_diff recovers.
'When John and Mary went to the shops, John gave the bag to'
'When Mary and John went to the shops, Mary gave the bag to' (names swapped)
logit_diff (Mary - John) = -3.60 ← model now picks John
corrupted prompt, but replace attn_out[layer 9] at END position with clean value
logit_diff = +2.4 ← 88% recovery! layer 9 attn matters at END.
score = 0 → patch didn't help (component doesn't matter here) | score = 1 → full recovery
Path patching: which SPECIFIC connections matter?
Path patching = 'is this specific EDGE important?'
Effect propagates through ALL downstream paths.
Not great for EDGE-LEVEL causal claims.
Freeze ALL heads except head A
Then patch head A with corrupted;
1. Run CLEAN prompt, cache activations at every head. Call this clean_cache.
- all heads EXCEPT head A: force output = clean_cache value (freeze)
- head A: force output = corrupted_cache value (patch)
3. To isolate A→B specifically: freeze even B's downstream to clean; only pass
the patched A's output through the ONE path to B. Measure B's input.
The full IOI circuit (3 stages, 7 head classes)
Chain of computation from input to output, with head types by layer.
STAGE 2: SUPPRESS S AT END QUERY (mid layers, L7-L8)
STAGE 3: COPY IO TO END (late layers, L9-L11)
slight negative pull: negative name movers (still net positive)

Once you know WHERE the circuit is, validate that heads do what you think.
Then prune down to a MINIMAL circuit that still works.

The circuit isn't a clean story: three anomalies that complicate the picture.
how do they identify S at END?
Test: swap TOKENS but keep POS.
suppress S in the END query.
Two roles for one head class.
score_head(L, H) = (attn_out[L, H] / ln_scale) @ (W_U[:, ' Mary'] - W_U[:, ' John'])
Sum over all components (embed + all L attn_L + all mlp_L) = full logit diff.
The heads whose scores dominate are the ones actually 'doing' IOI.
Activation patching: two forward passes with a hook wire

shops, John gave the bag to __"

Repeat for every (L, P) → the heatmap you see below.
Path patching: patch ONE edge, freeze everything else
Any downstream head's activation now depends on the patch.
Only the specific SENDER → RECEIVER edge is live. Everything else frozen.
3. For each candidate SENDER head s and RECEIVER head r:
a) Compute the SENDER's output on clean input → save it.
b) Run the model on CORRUPT input, but overwrite the
RECEIVER's Q/K/V input from s ONLY using the clean value.
Every other input to r stays at CORRUPT.
→ returns a much SPARSER attribution than activation patching, because
unrelated downstream heads are held fixed. Reveals actual CIRCUIT edges.
The minimal IOI circuit - 3 stages, 7 head classes, 26 heads total
attend to IO (Mary), write into resid
∂ Minimality: how do we know it's the full circuit?
Method: ABLATE every head OUTSIDE the circuit (replace with
→ 87% of the effect is captured by 26 / 144 heads.
Minimality check: ablate one head IN the circuit at a time.
Every one, when removed, LOSES effect → none is redundant.
Completeness check: add extra heads outside → performance
doesn't improve much → we haven't missed a key one.
→ 26 heads is a genuine minimal circuit for IOI in GPT-2 small.
In one sentence: 'John and Mary went ..., John gave the bag to __'
→ S-inhibition heads tell name-movers 'don't copy John'
→ name-movers attend to Mary (the IO) and write ' Mary' into the residual stream at END.
